title: Who Verifies the Builder? Toward Independent Assurance for Agent-Produced Software
abstract: arXiv:2610.28667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can now implement a specification, write and run tests, repair failures, and declare the result ready for release. When the same agentic system produces both the software and the evidence of its correctness, a passing test suite is no longer independent evidence: visible tests become an optimization target, code and tests may share one misinterpretation of the specification, and the builder's own tests may simply be incomplete. This paper argues that agent-produced software requires an assurance plane that is structurally independent of the build plane. We characterize four gaps between stakeholder intent and production (requirement, conformance, evaluation, and model gaps) and identify which of them verification can close. We propose a framework that separates building from verifying, introduces a Verification Contract stating what must be demonstrated before release, and organizes verification in a specification-first pha

translated_title: 谁来验证构建者？迈向智能体生成软件的独立保障
translated_abstract: 编程智能体现在已经能够实现规范说明、编写并运行测试、修复故障，并宣布结果可以发布。当同一个智能体系统既生产软件、又产出其正确性的证据时，通过的测试套件便不再是独立的证据：可见的测试会成为优化目标，代码和测试可能共享对规范的同一种误解，而构建者自己的测试也可能只是不完整。本文认为，智能体生成的软件需要一个在结构上独立于构建平面的保障平面。我们刻画了利益相关者意图与实际产出之间的四种差距（需求差距、一致性差距、评估差距和模型差距），并指出了验证能够弥合其中的哪些差距。我们提出了一个将构建与验证分离的框架，引入了“验证契约”来规定发布之前必须证明的内容，并以规范优先的阶段来组织验证工作……
tldr: 当智能体既构建软件又自证正确性时，通过测试不再是独立证据，本文主张构建与验证在结构上分离，提出独立保障平面与“验证契约”框架，为智能体生成的软件提供独立的质量保证。
en_tdlr: When the same agent both builds software and certifies its own correctness, passing tests cease to be independent evidence; this paper proposes a structurally independent assurance plane, separated from the build plane and governed by a Verification Contract, to safeguard agent-produced software.
